candidates.titulo: We still don’t know how people are really using AI
candidates.resumen: AI companies like Anthropic and OpenAI regularly publish reports on how people are using products like Claude and ChatGPT, but they only release the data they want us to see, AI researchers say.  “There is no independent source to corroborate it,” says Anka Reuel, a computer science PhD candidate at the Stanford Trustworthy AI Research…

candidates.titulo: Cursor capitalizes on GitHub frustration, launches rival hosting platform
candidates.resumen: Cursor, known for its AI Code Editor, is launching a new code-hosting platform to rival developers' long preferred favorite, GitHub.

candidates.titulo: OpenAI launches a safer ChatGPT for teens — years after teens started using it
candidates.resumen: ChatGPT for Teens adds age-appropriate safety measures, parental controls, and learning tools designed to steer teens away from harmful content — and from using AI to cheat on their homework.

candidates.titulo: ChatGPT is getting a dedicated mode for teens
candidates.resumen:
ChatGPT for Teens includes safeguards and parental controls. | Image: OpenAI	

OpenAI is introducing a dedicated ChatGPT mode for teenagers, combining existing youth safeguards and new safety features under one roof. The launch comes amid mounting public scrutiny over how AI tools affect younger users, as other platforms implement their own age checks and teen-specific protections.

candidates.titulo: Etched’s valuation doubles to $21B in a month
candidates.resumen: Jane Street has installed Etched's first shipped AI cluster system, and was so impressed, it led another massive round, the startup says.
